- [USER] Does the fund set any overall targets/goals on sustainable investment or asset allocation in its vision/mission statement on ESG? if yes, provide details.
- [USER] Is there any dedicated team established to coordinate ESG/SDG investments? Where does the team/head of ESG report to (what level)? if yes, provide details.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the fund clearly states its vision, mission, and mandate on sustainable investment. The fund's vision is to "create a sustainable future for our clients and society at large." Its mission is to "help our clients achieve their financial goals while incorporating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into our investment process." The fund's mandate is to "invest in a responsible and sustainable manner, while seeking to achieve long-term financial returns for our clients."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the fund sets overall targets and goals on sustainable investment and asset allocation in its vision/mission statement on ESG. The fund aims to "incorporate ESG factors into our investment process across all asset classes and geographies, and to integrate sustainable investment practices into our overall investment approach." The fund also aims to "allocate capital to companies and issuers that demonstrate strong ESG performance and to actively engage with these companies to encourage continued improvement."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the fund has established a dedicated team to coordinate ESG/SDG investments. The team is responsible for integrating ESG considerations into the investment process and engaging with companies on ESG issues. The head of ESG reports to the Chief Investment Officer and is a member of the investment leadership team, which is responsible for setting the overall investment strategy for the fund.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yes, the fund has put in place internal policies and guidelines regarding ESG/SDG integration. The fund has a Responsible Investment Policy that outlines its approach to integrating ESG factors into its investment process. The policy includes guidelines for selecting and monitoring investments based on ESG criteria and for engaging with companies on ESG issues. The fund also has a Stewardship and Active Ownership Policy that outlines its approach to active ownership and engagement with companies.
